title: Run one auto node through brief, verification and review
name: auto-lifecycle
description: Build the opt-in single-node lifecycle over the core-authorized path: choose an actionable node, draft a concrete brief and runnable acceptance checks, approve with auto provenance, dispatch, review scan/verification/acceptance/CI/files, then accept only a conclusively green result or reject with actionable feedback. Search answered decisions before resolving a cross-node question; if the catalog lacks an answer for a choice that changes multiple nodes, stop and request human input. Stop and surface inconclusive evidence, overlap, failure or changed board state; never retry automatically. Land on development, never main. Keep the node's code and tests together.
